insights.text: Even when directional thesis is intact and price has moved favorably, hard-skip if current entry yields R:R < 1:2 to structural SL. Do not chase. BTCUSD 14:39 setup was thesis-correct but gave only 1.57R — correctly skipped.
insights.evidence: BTCUSD 14:39 trade: pullback bounced exactly as predicted, but entering at 75519 with SL 73700 gave R:R 1.57. Chasing would have been a rule break on an already-played move.

insights.text: In ranging regime, ONLY trade the documented extremes (support/resistance). Scanner-generated mid-range setups (e.g., pullback-to-EMA) contradict regime and must be skipped even if technicals look clean.
insights.evidence: XAUUSD 07:10: scanner suggested pullback at 4796 mid-range 4736-4891. Regime playbook explicitly said skip mid-range. Correctly passed.

insights.text: Scanner continues to generate setups on instruments explicitly tagged instruments_avoid by the regime layer. Treat any scanner signal on an avoid-listed instrument as auto-PASS without running full verification — saves decision cycles. Additionally, log these events as scanner bugs for the regime-gate fix.
insights.evidence: XAUUSD 2026-04-22: 2 scanner signals (15:09, 18:40) both on volatile_choppy/instruments_avoid regime. Same pattern seen earlier in week (XAUUSD 2026-04-20 ranging mid-level). Third occurrence of same class of scanner leak.
